notable_absence.finding: cbrecovery.md names the required roles as 'Full Administrator, Cluster Administrator, or XDCR Administrator' - the registry's role:cluster-admin and role:replication-admin entries (folded from Server's own 56-role catalogue at learn/security/roles.md) carry the aliases 'role:cluster-administrator' and 'role:xdcr-admin' respectively, i.e. the catalogue's own short forms are 'Cluster Admin' and 'XDCR Admin', not '...Administrator'. This page consistently spells out the longer '-istrator' form where the catalogue and REST/UI surfaces abbreviate. A minor but real, mechanically observable terminology drift, consistent with this round's authorship-provenance hypothesis: cbtools/ pages appear to have been written independently of the RBAC glossary's own preferred short names.

cross_component_finding: This page reinforces rather than duplicates the extraction-layer tool:cbrecovery record first seen on recover-data-with-xdcr.json - the same binary, now documented from its own dedicated cli/ reference page with a full options/flags table the task page didn't need. It also newly ties cbrecovery directly to the promoted server:vbucket and xdcr:reference concepts with fresh, page-specific evidence, strengthening both records' cross-tree recurrence.
cross_product_finding: cbrecovery is tied to a specific filesystem install path per platform and takes bare cluster URLs as positional arguments - no Capella-specific flag, gating language, or mention. XDCR recovery via this local binary against a live remote cluster is a Server (self-managed) operational pattern; no equivalent is stated for Capella.
